description: This file defines the QuestionController class, which is a REST controller managing CRUD operations for Question entities in a Spring Boot application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting questions.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller handling CRUD operations for Question objects.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a question by ID.
